sources.title: BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: New reranker model: release cross-encoder models BAAI/bge-reranker-base and BAAI/bge-reranker-large, which are more powerful than embedding model. We recommend to use/fine-tune them to re-rank top-k documents returned by embedding models.

sources.title: BGE v1 & v1.5 — BGE documentation - bge-model.com
sources.snippet: BGE v1 & v1.5 # BGE v1 and v1.5 are series of encoder only models base on BERT. They achieved best performance among the models of the same size at the time of release. BGE # The first group of BGE models was released in Aug 2023. The bge-large-en and bge-large-zh ranked 1st on MTEB and C-MTEB benchmarks at the time released.

sources.title: BGE large - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: BGE large is the top English model in the first BGE release from Aug-2023. The BGE docs describe the v1 family as encoder-only models based on BERT, and list bge-large-en at 335M parameters and 1.34 GB.

sources.title: bge-large-en-v1.5: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview bge-large-en-v1.5 is a dense retrieval embedding model designed for English-language semantic search and retrieval-augmented applications. Built by BAAI, it generates fixed-dimensional embeddings that enable efficient similarity matching between queries and documents.
